tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: There were very few people at the concert.
This is the most boring book I have ever read.
items.transformed: I have never read _________ this one.

items.original: We do not have enough chairs for everyone.
The journey took us six hours.
Almost nobody applied for the job.
The film was so good that we watched it twice.
items.transformed: It _________ that we watched it twice.

items.original: My sister earns twice what I earn.
items.transformed: My sister earns twice _________ I do.
